description: The term registry: every ontology term an NDI V2 import writes in a vocabulary slot (a variable, method, unit, condition, parameter, covariate, a relation name, an entity type or a channel type), so the next dataset reuses it. AUTHORED here; tools/validate_v_eta.py copies it into schemas/V_eta/stable/term_registry_meta.json, which did2.build checks against (strictMode 'TermRegistry'). Tenet T19; did_v2_term_registry_plan.md. status 'decided': a term with its node; 'staged': registered by name, its node still to be found or minted. `obsolete`: false, or {consider: <node>} for a term the ontology has made obsolete, kept while something still writes it. `number_unit`: false, or {node, name} of a registered unit term when the term's definition states the unit its accompanying number takes (Jess Haley, 2026-10-26, did_v2_go_forward_class_audit.md [term-stated unit is generic]): a migrator reads the unit from here, not from its own code. Every row carries the same keys (DID-matlab did2.schema.termIndex concatenates the rows). A new entry follows T19's order: a term already here, else an existing ontology's, else a new EMPTY term. `equivalent` (Jess Haley, 2026-10-27, did_v2_go_forward_class_audit.md [term equivalents recorded]): the ids in other vocabularies that mean the same thing as the term (e.g. an openMINDS instance for an NCBITaxon species; a Wikidata item), also for variable nodes (the node meaning species lists openMINDS's Species type); a list of CURIEs, filled by tools/fill_term_equivalents.py (Jess Haley, 2026-10-30, did_v2_go_forward_class_audit.md [equivalents filled in did-schema]), which writes exact equivalents only; the first fill is the species rows from openMINDS's species instances. `synonyms` (Jess Haley, 2026-10-26, did_v2_go_forward_class_audit.md [spelling is notation]): the spellings a migrator maps to this term, recorded so the mapping is documented and reversible as a set; read trimmed and ignoring case, never the term's own name and never another row's name or synonym; an unrecognised spelling is not guessed. Equivalent spellings of one term are the same thing in the round trip. Filled for DID-matlab `+migrators_j/private/jResponseVariable.m` (tuning `response_units`): om:hertz and EMPTY:0000397; empty elsewhere.
